methodologyNote: Measured via search host referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (mobile) in Canada at 92.6% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Google google.ca ranked second at 1.79%, followed by DuckDuckGo duckduckgo.com at 1.67%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (mobile) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 92.6% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/mobile/canada.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (mobile) in Canada?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (92.6%), Google google.ca (1.79%), DuckDuckGo duckduckgo.com (1.67%) in October 2026.
